mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within the last two months signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the last two months signals increased consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the last two months signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to increased prices and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in the last month, it signals inflationary pressure without corresponding monetary tightening, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3% within the last month, it signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 70% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% over the last two months signals increased consumer demand, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS increases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) increases by more than 2% and GDP (GDPC1) increases by more than 1% over the last quarter, it signals a strong supply-side expansion, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases > 2% and GDPC1 increases > 1% in 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.
